2608.21114.title: CIVA: Critic-Induced Value-Subspace Attacks on Visual World-Model Agents
2608.21114.paper_summary: Visual world-model agents such as DreamerV3 act through a recurrent latent state rather than a single observation, which weakens frame-wise observation attacks and makes their perturbations vary sharply over time under a strict per-frame perturbation constraint. We study white-box, causal, online attacks on such agents and propose Critic-Induced Value-Subspace Attacks (\textbf{CIVA}). Our key observation is that, along a rollout, critic-guided perturbations concentrate in a low-dimensional subspace induced by the victim's own critic. Based on this observation, CIVA first probes the frozen victim offline with critic-guided PGD and extracts a low-rank value-subspace by SVD. At test time, it optimizes only the subspace coefficients, smooths them with an exponential moving average (EMA), and maps them back to pixels. This design attacks value-sensitive recurrent dynamics while keeping the online optimization cheap and temporally coherent. Extensive experiments on DMC walker walk, Atari Pong, and Crafter show that CIVA consistently outperforms five recent methods; on DMC walker walk, it achieves the largest reward drop of 26.07\% while keeping temporal variation low, with TempAbs of 0.646.
2608.21114.paper_summary_zh: 視覺世界模型代理如 DreamerV3 透過循環潛在狀態而非單一觀察進行行動，這削弱了逐幀觀察攻擊，並使其擾動在嚴格的逐幀擾動約束下隨時間急劇變化。我們研究了對這類代理的白盒、因果、在線攻擊，並提出了批評者誘導的價值子空間攻擊（\textbf{CIVA}）。我們的關鍵觀察是，在一個展開過程中，批評者引導的擾動集中在由受害者自身的批評者誘導的低維子空間中。基於這一觀察，CIVA 首先使用批評者引導的 PGD 離線探測凍結的受害者，並通過 SVD 提取低秩價值子空間。在測試時，它僅優化子空間係數，使用指數移動平均（EMA）平滑它們，並將其映射回像素。這一設計攻擊價值敏感的循環動態，同時保持在線優化的成本低且時間一致。在 DMC walker walk、Atari Pong 和 Crafter 上的廣泛實驗顯示，CIVA 一直超越五種最近的方法；在 DMC walker walk 上，它實現了 26.07\% 的最大獎勵下降，同時保持時間變化低，TempAbs 為 0.646。
